items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: talk to and we sort of palled around together and we played down in Norfolk, Virginia.

ctx.x: Hernando something, I can't think of his name right now. Well, he was a very interesting man to

talk to and we sort of palled around together and we played down in Norfolk, Virginia. And coming back, we're going back and we had a special coach on the train. And I was walking back to the Pullman with him and this cop standing by the gate says, you go through the other gate, to me. I thought, what the hell's the difference. I said, "I'm talking to my friend." He said, "This gate's for niggers, this gate's for whites!" And then I looked up, engraved in the marble, I mean for history to find, 2000 years from…

So I said, you know, told him to screw himself. And he called me a Negro lover and I went over and hit him. So all hell broke loose. You see, you hit a sheriff down South and you're dead. And the Pullman porter, of all guys, he was real stinky to me on the way down, very unfriendly. He came up to me running and said, "You dumb son of a bitch," and he grabbed me and ran into the train, he put me into an upper berth and closed me in. And then the cops came, you know, they were searching all over that train for me.…
